title: PowerGrid: Progression
summary: Upgrade PowerGrid in stable steps without skipping the safety layer.

blocks.title: Upgrade Path
blocks.body: Progress by strengthening the weakest segment before adding load. Upgrade generation, storage, distribution, protection, and diagnostics in the order failures appear.

blocks.title: Do Not Skip The Middle
blocks.body: The middle step is usually boring because it is the safety layer: storage, markers, meters, counters, backups, or notes. Build that layer before raising the risk.

blocks.title: Ready For More
blocks.body: You are ready to push PowerGrid further when the current loop feels repeatable, the failure signs are familiar, and the next upgrade has a clear purpose.

blocks.title: Upgrade Anchor
blocks.body: Use this as the upgrade checkpoint before raising route risk.
blocks.label: Redstone
blocks.subtitle: Progression checkpoint
